policy: A baseline is a FROZEN claim about what was accepted, by whom, on what evidence.
It is never overwritten. A correction creates a new baseline and marks the old one SUPERSEDED or STALE, keeping the old outputs visible.

Automated PASS is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT: only the supervisor authorises PROMOTION. status ACTIVE below at CANDIDATE level means 'this run passed its automation gates'; it does not mean the science is accepted.
While any blocker in reports/PHASE_01C_OPEN_BLOCKERS.json has promotion_blocked=true, no baseline may be created at APPROVED level at all.
